headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a thrilling 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. leading the team with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs. In other action, the Texas Rangers edged the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2, with Nathan Lukes hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Baltimore Orioles left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. Other players on the injured list include Matt Shaw (Chicago Cubs), Ethan Roberts (Chicago Cubs), Jacob Wilson (Athletics), Tyler Soderstrom (Athletics), Anthony Banda (Minnesota Twins), David Morgan (San Diego Padres), and Richard Lovelady (Washington Nationals).

The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired in a trade with the San Francisco Giants for cash. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Owen Carapellotti.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a hard-fought win over the Baltimore Orioles, with a strong performance from Luis García Jr. who led the team with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Pirates in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 9-4 defeat at the hands of the Pittsburgh Pirates. Ryan O'Hearn led the Reds' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a narrow win over the Toronto Blue Jays, with a final score of 3-2. Nathan Lukes led the Rangers' offense with a standout performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 7-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers in a closely contested matchup. Isaac Paredes led the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, while Jack Flaherty pitched 5 strong innings for the Astros, striking out 9 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Place Keegan Akin on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to June 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired in a trade with the San Francisco Giants for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners in a move that shakes up the team's lineup.
